parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: A wooden cabinet door made of MDF, rectangular in shape, part of the front enclosure of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the storage compartments by opening and closing.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a vertical hinge axis to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: A second wooden cabinet door made of MDF, located adjacent to the first door.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to another section of the cabinet storage.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a vertical hinge axis to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: A lower cabinet door made of MDF, part of the bottom section of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It covers and protects the lower storage compartment.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a vertical hinge axis to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: A fourth cabinet door made of MDF, completing the front enclosure of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the final section of the cabinet storage.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a vertical hinge axis to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The main structural frame of the cabinet made of MDF, forming the outer shell and support for doors and shelves.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural integrity and houses the doors and shelves.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving structural component.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: A horizontal wooden shelf inside the cabinet, made of MDF.
parts.Functional_description: It supports stored items and divides the cabinet interior into sections.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or occasionally adjustable vertically but does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: A middle shelf made of MDF, providing additional storage space.
parts.Functional_description: It supports items placed in the middle section of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or occasionally adjustable vertically but does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: An upper shelf made of MDF, located near the top of the cabinet interior.
parts.Functional_description: It supports items stored in the upper section of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or occasionally adjustable vertically but does not move during normal use.
